rules.statement: A subsequent sale by an administratrix with a Court order takes priority over a Fiscal's sale, but the registration of the conveyance is crucial for establishing title.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held , that plaintiff had a superior title. Aserappa v. Weeratunga 1 [ 1 (1911) 14 N. L. R. 417. ] and Tikiri Banda v. Loku Banda 2 [ 2 (1911) 15 N. L. R. 63. ] -followed."
